name: Nageur des Courants
description: Éclaireur aquatique sondant les profondeurs inconnues du secteur pour identifier les zones accessibles aux colonies.

loadout.armor_outfit: Heavy pressure-hardened polymer exosuit with layered rust‑orange and verdigris plating, massive spherical titanium‑alloy helmet filled with cyan bioluminescent fluid, bulky hydraulic joints with exposed copper cooling coils, steam vent valves, thick armored glass visor, integrated rebreather tubes.
loadout.arsenal: Integrated thermal mining saw on left forearm, dual wrist‑mounted plasma cutter pistols, built‑in sonar headlamp emitting a cyan beam, portable depth‑probe micro‑drone.

attitude.behavior: Hovering in mid‑water, gliding with slow, powerful fin strokes while sweeping the environment with a bright cyan sonar beam; steam and bubbles erupt from pressure‑release valves; water vapor clings to the suit’s surface.
attitude.emotion: Focused, vigilant, alien curiosity; cold, calculating stare through the visor; a sense of probing the unknown depths.

palette_names.name: Cyan Bioluminescent
palette_names.role: Helmet fluid, energy accents, sonar beam

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Cinematic underwater illumination: a single powerful halogen projector mounted on the suit casts a sharp cyan beam, supplemented by ambient bioluminescent glow from the alien’s visor and faint orange thermal light from vents; strong contrast with deep shadows; volumetric fog and caustic ripples create depth.

scenography.setting: Submerged abyssal trench beneath a ruined offshore mining platform; twisted metal girders, broken pipelines, floating sediment, distant faint colony lights glimmering through the murk.
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Heavy underwater fog, drifting particles, bubbles erupting from pressure valves, occasional electric arcs, steam vents, cyan bioluminescent particles swirling, faint orange plasma flares.
